baseline: OWASP MASVS/MASTG + MASWE v1.0.0; Apple/Google platform integrity, privacy and store-security guidance; Tailmance source/runtime scope
policy: implement applicable controls; explicitly document controls that are absent by architecture instead of adding unused attack surface

short_access_jwt.detail: Supabase source config jwt_expiry=900; hosted config remains release evidence.

secure_mobile_token_storage.detail: Native auth storage uses Expo SecureStore/Keychain/Keystore semantics; web storage is not used as a mobile-token substitute.

immediate_session_revocation.detail: Global logout/password reset/operator revocation close the already-issued-JWT grace window through server-side session-id and per-user revocation state.

certificate_or_spki_pinning.detail: Do not ship brittle single-leaf pins for managed Apple/Google/RevenueCat/Supabase certificates. Production host inventory must document SPKI+backup-pin/rotation feasibility for any first-party endpoint Tailmance actually controls, otherwise a reviewed risk decision is required.

websocket_tls.detail: Supabase Realtime derives secure transport from the configured HTTPS project origin; cleartext mobile transport is blocked.

private_realtime_chat_authorization.detail: Conversation typing uses a private Supabase Realtime Broadcast channel. realtime.messages SELECT/INSERT policies authorize only authenticated owners of pets in the active match; typing payload carries no client-asserted pet identity and expires client-side. Production must verify the Supabase Realtime Allow public access setting and private-channel behavior on the deployed project.

webrtc_srtp_turn.detail: Matched-pet audio/video calls use LiveKit/WebRTC with server-authoritative active-session, current legal/product-access, active-match and block-state checks, room-scoped short-lived participant JWTs, native iOS CallKit + PushKit and Android self-managed Telecom/ConnectionService bridges. Terminal call states and account-deletion cascades transactionally enqueue a service-only teardown outbox; a secret-protected worker uses LiveKit Room Service to forcibly delete rooms with retry/backoff. System actions are re-authorized in JS/server state; Expo and APNs VoIP token transports are isolated. Production LiveKit/TURN, scheduled teardown-worker operation/monitoring, real APNs VoIP credentials/delivery, and representative physical-device background/killed-state media/system-call QA remain external release gates. Tailmance does not claim application-layer E2EE.

iap_server_authoritative_validation.detail: RevenueCat server webhook + subscriber reconciliation are authoritative; client purchase state alone cannot grant server product access.

root_jailbreak_debugger_emulator_detecti.detail: Native heuristics feed server risk evidence but never revoke/ban by themselves; platform attestation remains authoritative for sensitive actions.

clipboard_sensitive_data.detail: No auth token/password/private health-document secret is copied to the system clipboard by application code.

local_database_encryption.detail: Replay-safe offline social mutations use a native-only SQLCipher SQLite queue. The SQLCipher key is generated with the native OS CSPRNG, stored in SecureStore/Keychain with this-device-only accessibility, bound to the authenticated account, capacity-bounded, and never used for payments, legal consent, account deletion, health verification, boosts, or super-likes. Native release binaries must still verify SQLCipher linkage and background execution on physical iOS/Android devices.

message_e2ee.detail: Tailmance private messages remain server-readable for report/block/moderation and legal safety workflows. No claim of E2EE is made. A future E2EE design requires a separate abuse-report evidence mechanism and cryptographic review before release.

outbound_provider_ssrf_allowlist.detail: Moderation, identity-verification and App Attest verifier server calls require credential-free HTTPS, exact DNS-host allowlists, default TLS port and reject localhost/literal-IP targets; identity provider return links use the same allowlist.

operator_external_link_safety.detail: Pet-friendly place, partner and commercial-offer URLs are constrained server-side and revalidated on mobile before opening; credential-bearing, localhost, literal-IP and explicit-port links are rejected.

web_transport_response_headers.detail: Source requests CSP, HSTS, no-referrer, nosniff, frame denial, Permissions-Policy and legacy plugin isolation; deployed header/TLS scan remains external evidence.

edge_log_pii_hygiene.detail: Edge production logs are restricted by regression test to fixed non-PII event codes and never serialize request/auth/user/provider payloads.

tls_protocol_policy.detail: Tailmance blocks cleartext transport. Production endpoints must support TLS 1.2 or later and should negotiate TLS 1.3 where available; no false TLS-1.3-only claim is made because managed providers and store server notification endpoints require interoperable TLS 1.2+.

store_server_notifications_and_billing_l.detail: RevenueCat is the server-side purchase authority. App Store Server Notifications V2/JWS and Google RTDN/PubSub delivery plus purchase/restore/renewal/cancel/refund/revocation/transfer lifecycle remain mandatory deployed evidence.

android_target_api_36.detail: Android production source targets API 36 for the 2026 Google Play requirement; the actual AAB manifest remains release-binary evidence.

ios_privacy_manifest_and_required_reason.detail: Source declares no tracking in the Expo privacy manifest. Dependency-resolved archive must still be inspected for merged PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy, SDK manifests/signatures and Required Reason API declarations before App Store release.

account_deletion_in_app_and_web.detail: Tailmance has in-app hard deletion and an external web deletion path. Google Play console must point to the deployed deletion URL; Apple review must verify the in-app path and Sign in with Apple token revocation where applicable.

moderation_text_image_manual_fallback.detail: Tailmance moderates applicable text/image/video UGC with provider wiring, deterministic pet-sale/rehoming policy enforcement, report/block and manual-review fallback. Reels require a sanitized MP4 derivative before approval; production classifier quality and operational SLA remain external evidence.

development_memory_leak_detection.detail: LeakCanary is injected only into Android debug builds and is explicitly excluded from release. Image uploads are bounded, re-encoded and metadata-stripped; iOS memory behavior remains physical-device/release profiling evidence.

async_heavy_work_nonblocking.detail: Network, storage, media manipulation and cryptographic/integrity work use async/native/server paths rather than synchronous UI-thread loops. Physical-device performance/ANR proof remains external observability evidence.

private_postgis_spatial_indexing.detail: Exact pet coordinates remain private. Discovery, Pati Radar and pet-friendly-place radius filtering use WGS-84 geography(Point,4326), GiST indexes and ST_DWithin; client-visible distance remains approximate.

verified_universal_and_app_links.detail: Shared pet-profile links are strict-parsed, cannot bypass bootstrap/legal/profile gates, and require server-authorized target visibility before navigation. AASA/assetlinks generation fails closed until real production domain, Apple Team ID and Android signing SHA-256 values are supplied and deployed.

pet_sale_and_rehoming_zero_tolerance.detail: Pet sales, commercial-breeding marketplace activity, adoption/rehoming offers and pet-ownership transfer solicitation are blocked by client preflight, database triggers and moderation-provider policy across protected UGC/profile surfaces.

on_device_edge_ai_prefilter.detail: Tailmance has native iOS Core ML/Vision and Android MediaPipe Tasks Vision classifier bridges integrated into pet-photo flows. Runtime-downloaded model artifacts are HTTPS same-origin constrained, size bounded and exact SHA-256 verified before native execution. A high-confidence local safety block can prevent upload; all other outcomes still require authoritative server moderation. Breed output is advisory and changes profile data only after explicit user selection. Model provenance/license/quality thresholds and physical-device performance remain mandatory external release evidence.
